== Ingredients ==

* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 2 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|cider vinegar]]

* 1 boneless [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] loin roast
* 3 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Barbecue Rub|Barbecue Rub]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine mustard and vinegar, and rub all over pork.
#Coat pork evenly with the Barbecue Rub.
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] on a preheated grill, turning often until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63˚C).
#Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve.
